title: Winter Hiking Tips
claims: Winter conditions require layers of clothing, warm outer layers, sunglasses, sunscreen, water and snacks.
Traction devices are recommended on ice and snow, and snowshoes or traction devices are often needed.
Do not rely on cell phones; carry a map and compass or GPS and know how to use them.
Check the weather and trail conditions, tell someone your plans and expected return time, and be willing to turn around.
Snow-covered landscapes can hide trail markers; do not rely on other people's tracks.
